overview: The Warmaster’s expedition returns to Davin, where an apparently straightforward campaign becomes a test of trust and ambition.
synopsis: Horus returns to Davin after reports that its governor has rebelled. Loken, Torgaddon and the rest of the Mournival accompany a fleet increasingly divided by warrior lodges, political demands and private influence. Erebus helps direct the Warmaster toward a confrontation on Davin’s moon.

A terrible wound leaves Horus dependent on the rituals of the Serpent Lodge. Within his visions, Erebus and Magnus offer competing interpretations of the future. Meanwhile, the treatment of ordinary humans aboard the fleet worsens, and Loken’s doubts about the forces around his commander deepen.
detailed: Erebus brings news of disloyalty on Davin, presenting the rebellion of Eugen Temba as a personal affront to Horus. The Warmaster’s position has already been strained by the work of administering conquered worlds and the Emperor’s absence. He decides to confront his former subordinate directly.

The expedition lands on Davin’s moon and encounters a landscape transformed by corruption. Temba, now grotesquely altered, wounds Horus with the stolen anathame. Conventional treatment cannot save him. Erebus proposes the Serpent Lodge as a possible remedy, and the desperate attempt to preserve the Warmaster carries him into its ritual sanctuary.

Inside an experience constructed from visions and deception, Erebus adopts the appearance of Sejanus and shows Horus a future in which he is forgotten while the Emperor is worshipped. Magnus intervenes to expose the deception and urge his brother to turn away. Horus nevertheless accepts a course that sets him against the Emperor.

Outside the sanctuary, Loken and Torgaddon investigate the circumstances of the wound and grow suspicious of Erebus. On the flagship, the ordinary remembrancers find the atmosphere increasingly threatening. Keeler’s religious conviction develops in opposition to the official rejection of faith, while Karkasy’s criticism makes him a target.

Horus returns to command. The expedition’s public direction and its private intentions are no longer the same. The fleet’s movement toward Isstvan creates the next crisis, while Loken remains aware that something fundamental has changed without yet understanding its full extent.
